abi_status: active atomic ABI: 23 inputs and 6 outputs; the official C8 inputs 0..8 and outputs 0..1 keep their original order and types, while P9 appends graph-visible fixed-slot, execution-row physical mapping, and active-row controls without a redundant resident-payload pointer

operator_abi.resident_payload: not an operator input or output: the caller's normal resident allocation is carried by layer_resident_get_control, and attention_slots is the only terminal payload-facing result

source_derived_from.topk_owner: official ProcessTopK selection and original sparse-index writeback stay unchanged; P9 invokes its terminal direct-resident finalizer after the original V->MTE3 completion and before that unchanged sparse-index writeback, without consuming TOPK_MTE3_V

resource_model.worker_assignment: any C8 worker may dynamically acquire an invocation-local queue

canonical_resident_slots.meaning: caller-reserved stable logical QSFA slots; execution row r resolves pool p=req_pool_entries[r], while physical Direct-HCCP output is resident_block_table[r, logical_slot/128]*128+(logical_slot%128)

active_row_gate.meaning: only rows [0, active_row_count) may access P9 pool/table/control state; graph padding rows may alias a pool row but perform no P9 score, post, finalizer, or output action

candidate_seed.slot_assignment: one candidate receives one distinct fixed-table ordinal before PostOnly; descriptor physical output is resolved only from the execution-row resident_block_table

maps.candidate_source_to_slot: int32[R, S], initialized to -1; written only after the fully published descriptor is accepted by PostOnly
maps.candidate_slot_cursor: int32[R], invocation-local monotonic admission cursor; it only prevents duplicate initial posts and is not used for cross-invocation reuse

candidate_seed.cross_wave_slot_invariant: CandidateCompact never assigns one resident_slot_ordinal to two initial waves; Stage-B drains every initial wave before it may reuse a non-winner entry in the same invocation for exact recall; admission verifies the complete fixed logical table is disjoint from persistent object slots before any PostOnly

stage_a.name: score_scan_candidate_post
stage_a.rule: observe exact tile scores, compact only cold candidates, and PostOnly to the supplied fixed resident slot without modifying official C8 score or Top-K state

stage_b.name: topk_recall_and_terminal_drain
stage_b.qsfa_contract: QSFA consumes only final attention_slots after this condition holds
